name: Text Reveal
description: Full-screen sections of large centered text where each line slides up from behind a mask in a staggered reveal as it scrolls into view, and resets when it leaves.
contents: Full-height sections, each with one centered paragraph of large text
behavior: Text is split into lines, each wrapped in an overflow mask and slid up with a stagger when the paragraph reaches the viewport bottom
Animation resets when scrolling out and replays on re-entry
Lines are re-split and animations rebuilt after the layout resizes, debounced
editableByProps: Number of sections and all paragraph text
Smoothness of scrolling, stagger, easing and resize debounce

needsCodeEdit.where: @import url line and .text-reveal-root rule in the style block

needsCodeEdit.change: Change text size or line height
needsCodeEdit.where: style prop fontSize and lineHeight on the root div

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Each section is at least one full viewport tall
Loads the Poppins font through a Google Fonts import
